blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy forge bellows set in a timber frame. It features a teardrop-shaped bellows with pleated burgundy leather sides secured by brass studs between light-toned wooden plates. A long wooden lever handle with a cloth/rope-wrapped grip is attached to the top board via an iron hinge mechanism. At the front end is a cast-iron conical exhaust nozzle. The whole assembly rests in a sturdy green-stained wooden cradle reinforced with brass-studded black iron brackets.
blind.from_above: A teardrop-shaped wooden top board aligned horizontally, with a dark iron nozzle on the left and a straight wooden pump handle extending to the right with wrapped twine on the grip, resting inside a rectangular green timber frame with four upright corner posts.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly one-third as tall as the figure (about 2 ft tall) and around 2.5 to 3 ft long.
